bikeReasons.incomplete_link: Link is missing a code or native ID
bikeReasons.missing_native: Stored ID missing from the BIKETREK catalog
bikeReasons.changed_identity: BIKETREK code or parent differs from the link

title: Atomer migration status
scope: Each sellable Atomer code, its inventory card and links in both shops. xTrek status covers catalog identity and linking. Content and quantities are checked separately.

states.needs_both: No confirmed card or xTrek match

emptySource: Upload buyers.xml for the first check. Later checks can reuse the saved export.

errors.failed: The check failed. Reload the overview.
errors.remote_read_failed: The complete xTrek catalog could not be verified. The last completed result is displayed.
errors.refresh_in_progress: Another check is running. Reload the page when it completes.
errors.review_changed: Another change was saved. Close the editor and reload before editing.
errors.run_changed: Catalog refreshed. Open the current detail.
errors.invalid_targets: The list requires unique native product and variant IDs, source and target parents, codes, EANs and attributes.
errors.target_pin_changed: A saved ID has a different identity. Check the original review list.
errors.target_recheck_required: Identity or evidence changed. Review the target again.
errors.verify_removal_first: Refresh the catalog to verify removal first.
errors.working_first_reopen: The task is in progress. Check prior effects and return it to open before editing.
errors.family_manages_work: The product manages this work. Open its decision first.
errors.active_child_work: A variant already has an active task. Finish or withdraw it first.
errors.invalid_admin_export: The CSV needs a unique catalog code and visibility. Check the headers and duplicate rows.
errors.incomplete_admin_export: A complete CSV needs catalog codes, parent links and every item in the source XML. You can save a selection with the full-catalog option unchecked.
errors.export_size: The file is empty or too large.
errors.admin_source_required: Removal requires the complete Atomer export including hidden items.

reasons.duplicate_source: Source records disagree for this catalog code.
reasons.target_claimed: Multiple Atomer codes claim this xTrek listing.
reasons.kind_differs: A variant matches a standalone product.
reasons.parent_differs: More than one parent product matches this family.
reasons.occupied_parameters: Another xTrek listing occupies these parameters.
reasons.different_shop_link: The card already has a different xTrek link.
reasons.link_identity_differs: The existing link has a different code or parent.

wholeFamily: This decision covers the entire family, including its variants.
deletionHelp: Yes approves only this xTrek variant ID. Processing requires a complete source check and a review of stock, links and orders.
instructionHelp: Saving a new instruction queues it for processing. The internal note stays with the item.

instructions.identity: Compare code, EAN, parent and attributes against Atomer. Record the cause of any conflict.
instructions.card: Check existing stock cards. For a proven identity reuse the card or create a missing one under warehouse rules.
instructions.linkX: Verify identity and link the existing card to the exact xTrek product or variant. Verify its IDs.
instructions.targetX: Prepare the missing xTrek item from Atomer. Verify parent and variant visibility and flags before publication.
instructions.checkB: Check the BIKETREK native IDs, parent and code. Record the result.
instructions.linkB: Find and verify the BIKETREK match, then link the exact variant or standalone product.
instructions.verify: Verify the card and links in the intended shops. Record verified IDs and differences.
instructions.inspectExtra: Check the complete Atomer source, identity, stock, orders, reservations and links for this item. Record a recommendation.

removeIntro: Choose an exact xTrek variant and save the decision. No closes its review. Yes queues the approved variant for pre-removal checks.
queueIntro: Saved instructions appear here. The verified result or blocker stays with the product.
approvedRemoval: Approved removal review for this exact variant.
inAtomer: This item exists in the source export.

checks.eligible: Absent from buyers.xml. xTrek identity matches.
checks.in_source: Source match found. Keep and investigate.

warn.occupied: An Atomer variant has the same attributes and a different EAN.
warn.linked: This variant has a stock card link.
warn.admin_absence_unknown: Removal requires the complete Atomer export including hidden items.

adminFile: Product export from the Atomer admin (CSV)
adminCompleteLabel: This CSV includes the whole catalog with hidden products and variants
adminConflicts: Repeated codes with different CSV records ({{n}}). Review {{codes}}.
adminQuarantine: Rows with unreadable identifiers ({{n}}). Find them under Atomer internal IDs {{ids}}. Removal tasks remain blocked pending verification.
adminCoverage: Codes in CSV {{codes}} · Sellable items only in CSV {{added}}
activityHelp: Activity is visibility in Atomer. A missing parent record is shown as unknown.
